title: Add Wave 12 cache, catalogue, and pricing invariant verifiers in susi-harness

criteria: CacheBounds::verify_bounds_invariants and ResponseCache::verify_cache_invariants validate cache capacity and accounting invariants
PriceCatalogue::verify_catalogue_invariants validates schema, model keys, and model prices
TokenUsage::verify_usage_invariants and ModelPrice::verify_price_invariants validate token accounting and rate invariants
